notes.title: 💼 Attention, Agents: Operation Autumn Sale Is a Go! 💼
notes.content:
The mission begins on [b]November 27[/b]—and your objective is clear: secure[b] Stealth Assault: Urban Strike[/b] at an unbeatable discount during the [b]Steam Autumn Sale![/b] 🍂🎮

🎯 [b]Your tools of the trade:[/b]
- High-octane stealth missions in dynamic urban settings.
- Gadgets and strategies to outsmart your enemies.
- Thrills, danger, and adrenaline at every turn!

💣 [b]Mission briefing:[/b] Be prepared to strike swiftly, because this deal won’t last forever. The shadows await your mastery.
🕶️ [b]Gear up and claim your discount—November 27 is just around the corner![/b]
